title: Execution imagery — slippage-cost-models-backtest (hero + 4 chapters)
body:
## Goal

Generate **5 premium-dark images** (1 hero + 4 chapters) for the Marketmaker.cc blog post **"Slippage curves, not slippage constants: cost models that survive contact with live trading"** — slug **`slippage-cost-models-backtest`**. Part of the **Execution batch 2** (5 posts); this issue covers ONE post. Use GPT image generation, commit under `blog/`, open a PR.

Context (for the artist, do not render as text): replace a flat constant-bps slippage assumption with cost curves that depend on size, volatility and liquidity. A ladder M0→M3: constant bps, spread-proportional, volatility-scaled, square-root-in-participation (Almgren sqrt-law). Fit the curve from your own TCA fills or public data. Regimes multiply the same order's cost several-fold. The punchline: swapping cost models reshuffles the strategy leaderboard — rank inversions — and honest PnL becomes a band, not a point.

## 📁 Where to put the images

- Commit every file to this repo under **`blog/`**.
- Hero filename **must** equal `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest.png` to match `image: /images/blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest.webp`.

## ⚠️ Quality gate

Decode each PNG before committing — coherent premium-dark visualization matching its prompt, not noise. Target **1664×936** (exact 16:9). Clean 16:9 ≈ 0.5–1.5 MB.

## Output spec

- **16:9** every image. **PNG**, high quality. **No text**.
- **Shared color language (Execution batch):** emerald/cyan = the realistic curve / honest cost / true ranking; red-orange = the naive constant assumption & the cost that blows up under stress; purple-magenta = the market medium (depth, volatility); amber = the model-ladder / fitted-curve mechanism; muted grey-blue = raw fills / baseline. Deep navy-to-black background, glassmorphism, glowing data paths, semi-transparent layers, depth of field, glowing particles, subtle grid. Abstract data-viz / isometric — no photos, no people, no logos, no readable text.

## Filenames (exactly)
- hero — `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest.png`
- `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest-cost-ladder.png`
- `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest-sqrt-law.png`
- `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest-regime-stress.png`
- `blog/slippage-cost-models-backtest-leaderboard-reshuffle.png`

## Prompts

**hero** — A premium dark abstract contrasting a slippage constant with a slippage curve. A flat red-orange constant-cost line lying dumbly across all order sizes, versus a glowing emerald cost curve that bends upward with size, steepens under a purple-magenta volatility field and flattens where liquidity is deep — a living surface instead of a number. An order sliding along the curve pays a cost that clearly depends on where it sits. Deep navy-to-black, glassmorphism, glowing particles, depth of field, subtle grid. 16:9. No text.

**cost-ladder** — The four-rung cost-model ladder as ascending amber tiers, each a small glowing cost-vs-size plot of increasing realism: M0 a flat constant line, M1 a spread-proportional step, M2 a volatility-scaled curve widening in turbulence, M3 a concave square-root-in-participation curve. Realism climbing upward toward emerald. Deep navy-to-black, glassmorphism, soft glow. 16:9. No text.

**sqrt-law** — The square-root law of market impact: a glowing concave emerald curve where cost grows with the square root of participation rate / order size — doubling size less than doubles cost per unit but total impact keeps climbing — plotted against a faint red-orange straight-line (naive linear) for contrast, a cloud of purple-magenta fitted data points hugging the sqrt curve. Deep navy-to-black, glowing data paths, depth of field. 16:9. No text.

**regime-stress** — The same order costing five times as much across regimes: one identical order fired into five market states — calm emerald (cheap), normal, choppy, stressed, and a red-orange crisis where the purple-magenta book is thin and impact explodes — a glowing stress-multiplier dial scaling the cost bar up several-fold from calm to crisis. Deep navy-to-black, glassmorphism, glowing particles. 16:9. No text.

**leaderboard-reshuffle** — Rank inversion when the cost model changes: two glowing strategy leaderboards side by side, ranked bars connected by crossing luminous lines — a strategy sitting proudly at the top under a naive red-orange constant model tumbles down the ranking under an honest emerald square-root model, the order reshuffled, and each strategy's PnL shown as a band not a point. Deep navy-to-black, glassmorphism, depth of field. 16:9. No text.

## Acceptance

- 5 PNGs at the exact paths above, all 16:9 (1664×936), text-free, verified non-corrupted, consistent with the batch. `blog/README.md` mapping entry. Open a PR.
